text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day while walking through town, I 
spotted a familiar figure.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes—I am on my way to the flower shop 
where I met you previously, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Actually—one of Loves-san's stream 
community members happened to ask me for a 
favor.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you all for tuning in today, 
everyone♪ And to Bouquet-chan who joined 
as our guest too!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Arranging a bouquet filled with feelings 
to express your love." It was such a 
lovely, heart-filled guest segment♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Love me♡ Love you♡ This has 
been Loves Only You—♡

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—The guest appearance on Loves-san's 
stream. I am relieved it concluded without 
incident.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a direct message...? From—one of 
Loves-san's community members?

text_block_list.name: Easily Distracted Girl
text_block_list.text:
"That last segment touched my heart so 
much! So... Bouquet-chan, please, won't 
you help us out?!"

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The community members—also wish to gift a 
bouquet filled with love—to Loves-san.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
From her—they constantly receive so much 
love. They wish to return that very same 
love to her.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. And so, I offered to help, asking if 
I could please collaborate with them.

text_block_list.name: Easily Distracted Girl
text_block_list.text: "Our feelings for Loves-chan, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Easily Distracted Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since she was little, watching her 
give her all with that positive attitude 
was so cute, I couldn't take my eyes off 
her. I feel like I just want to watch over 
her forever~"

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Gym Bro
text_block_list.text:
"Even when I'm feeling down, her love and 
smile cheer me right up. To me, she's like 
the sun itself!"

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Every single sentiment—is so gentle and 
warm. I am certain we can create a 
marvelous bouquet.
choice_data_list: Mind if I help out with that too?
Mind if I help out with that too?

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Eh?
choice_data_list:
I'd like to help to repay you for the 
other day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after buying all the flowers 
together with Karen Bouquetd'or, we 
returned to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Flowers chosen to reflect everyone's 
feelings. —Every single one is gorgeous. I 
am looking forward to—bundling them into 
one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The colorful array of flowers before us 
spoke volumes of just how much love was 
directed toward Loves Only You.
choice_data_list:
It looks like it might be tricky to tie 
them all together.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It may seem so at first glance— but if we 
follow the guidance that harmony provides, 
we will surely find the answer...

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The language of flowers—the hues, the way 
they blossom. We find the connections 
between the flowers and weave them 
together.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
So that soon, it becomes a bouquet— a 
unified symbol of all their feelings.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"You are my source of energy!"— "Hope that 
reaches across the sea"— "Always watching 
over you, now and forever"—

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—She is truly loved so deeply, isn't she? 
Loves-san.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Ever since they first consulted me— I 
have felt so happy, deep in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Loves-san, who wished to share her "love"— 
and all the fans, who wished to return 
those feelings... In a bond where they 
cherish and care for one another—

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
What a wondrous harmony it is— It truly 
touched my heart.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Being able to help everyone find that kind 
of happiness――

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And being able to witness that created 
harmony――truly brings me happiness.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ――Yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...From my community members, to me?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Aw, hehe! I'm usually the one on the 
receiving end of their love, though!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Bouquet-chan! I definitely 
received the ultimate love from everyone♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Being able to witness that created 
harmony truly brings me happiness"――Seeing 
her look so delighted, I felt like I 
finally understood what she meant.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes―― Ah.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Before presenting it to Loves-san―― I 
should share a photo of the bouquet with 
the community members as well.

text_block_list.name: Karen Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I am sure――they are eagerly waiting for 
it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Karen Bouquetd'or, always considerate of 
others and wholehearted in fostering 
harmony. I found myself admiring her 
wonderful way of being.
